t: Arthur: D.W. Aims High/Flaw and Order
st: D.W. Aims High/Flaw and Order
d: D.W. wants to be the first person to set foot on Mars! But what if scary purple aliens eat her? Who's responsible for cracking Dad's cake platter? DUN-DUN! All the evidence points to Arthur!

t: Arthur: All Thumbs/Kidonia
st: All Thumbs/Kidonia
d: When Arthur catches Buster sucking his thumb, Buster worries that Arthur will tell the entire school. Tired of doing chores, Arthur and friends decide to invent their own country. Will this kid-ruled utopia flourish or descend into anarchy?

t: Arthur: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline
st: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline
d: When painfully shy George brings a ventriloquist dummy to school, a popular kid is born! Then, Arthur thinks the best pet to have is a dog, and Francine probably would have agreed--that is, until little Nemo, a cute kitten, came along.

t: Arthur: Francine's Big Top Trouble/George Blows His Top
st: Francine's Big Top Trouble/George Blows His Top
d: Francine is sure she will be a star at circus camp. How hard could it be? Then, George is always more than happy to lend his pals whatever they need. But Buster's borrowing gets out of control.

t: Arthur: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish
st: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish
d: When Mom and Dad fight over spilled milk, Arthur and D.W. fear the worst. Is it Arthur's fault or D.W.'s? Then, turning five is a major, big deal event! But D.W. worries that she fribbled away her preschool years on meaningless pursuits.

t: Arthur: Fern and the Case of the Stolen Story/Sue Ellen Vegges Out
st: Fern and the Case of the Stolen Story/Sue Ellen Vegges Out
d: Fern has writer's block! Fortunately, Ladonna's full of stories, and Fern decides to "borrow" the tales and simply change the names. Then, when Sue Ellen decides to stop eating meat, Muffy and Francine compete to be the best vegetarian.

t: Arthur: Arthur's Tooth/D.W. Gets Lost
st: Arthur's Tooth/D.W. Gets Lost
d: It's bad enough to wear glasses all the time. But does Arthur have to be the last person in his class to lose his baby teeth? Then, if you think being lost in a humongous department store would scare a four-year-old, think again.

t: Arthur: D.W. Thinks Big/Arthur Cleans Up
st: D.W. Thinks Big/Arthur Cleans Up
d: Once again, Arthur gets to do everything. Mostly he gets to carry the ring in Aunt Lucy's wedding. Elwood City's park is in sad shape, and after grumbling about it, the kids find themselves volunteered to clean it up.

t: Arthur: Hide And Snake/Muffy's New Best Friend
st: Hide And Snake/Muffy's New Best Friend
d: The kids capture a snake and learn that it's possibly poisonous--after it gets lost in Arthur's house! Why is Muffy interviewing for a new best friend? She and Francine are usually inseparable, but lately it seems they have less in common.

t: Arthur: Arthur Read: Super Saver!/Tibbles to the Rescue!
st: Arthur Read: Super Saver!/Tibbles to the Rescue!
d: Business is slow for Mr. and Mrs. Read, and Arthur is concerned. Can he find ways to keep his family in the green? When D.W. saves Tommy and Timmy from a nasty fall, they decide to repay the favor…whether D.W. likes it or not.

t: Arthur: Arthur Makes Waves/It Came From Beyond
st: Arthur Makes Waves/It Came From Beyond
d: With the community pool closed for repairs and the temperature on the rise, Arthur and D.W. need a place to keep cool. Then, Grandma Thora takes in a stray: an adorable little dog named...Killer?

t: Arthur: Silent Treatment/Kung Fool
st: Silent Treatment/Kung Fool
d: When shy George wonders if any of his friends notice him, he decides he won’t speak to anyone until they do! Fern volunteers to help an elderly neighbor with his household chores, and then discovers his past life as a Kung Fu celebrity.

t: D.W. and the Beastly Birthday
d: Time to put on your party hats and dancing shoes – D.W. is turning five! When her birthday doesn’t go as planned, D.W. runs away to the magical island of Ukubonga. This is one party you don’t want to miss!

t: Arthur: MacFrensky/The Good The Bad and the Binky
st: MacFrensky/The Good The Bad and the Binky
d: Cheating comes in to play when Francine and Brain are locked in a stiff competition to win student of the month. Babysitter Binky introduces his charge to the world of pro-wrestling, but is he being a good role model?

t: Arthur: Lend Me Your Ear/The Butler Did It
st: Lend Me Your Ear/The Butler Did It
d: Arthur, Buster, and Brain are worried when Mr. Ratburn isn't acting like himself. He's always pleased to see them, so what’s made him change? When Mr. Crosswire gets a robot butler for Father's Day, Muffy fears Bailey may be replaced.

t: Arthur: Binky Vs. Binky/Operation: DW!
st: Binky Vs. Binky/Operation: DW!
d: Binky may be tough and strong, but when it comes to sports, he always seems to choke. D.W. is having trouble hearing and needs an ear operation. Is it okay to be just a little bit scared?

t: Arthur: Arthur Loses His Marbles/Friday The 13th
st: Arthur Loses His Marbles/Friday The 13th
d: When Arthur discovers that Grandma Thora is a marbles champion, he trains with her so he can beat all his friends. Then, Brain doesn't believe in superstitions, so when he has a string of bad luck, he's stunned.

t: Arthur: Fifteen
st: Fifteen
d: How much can Arthur and his friends do in 15 minutes? Can they all accomplish these missions impossible before the clock counts all the way down? Only time will tell!

t: Arthur: How The Cookie Crumbles/Sue Ellen's Littler Sister
st: How The Cookie Crumbles/Sue Ellen's Littler Sister
d: What's a budding entrepreneur to do when her homemade cookies hit the big time? Especially when the recipe isn't really hers? Then, Arthur and Francine would love to lend their sisters to Sue Ellen, who's sick of being an only child.

t: Arthur: Brain's Brain/Brain Sees Stars
st: Brain's Brain/Brain Sees Stars
d: Brain's Easter egg hunts are notoriously hard. But this year's might prove impossible if Brain can't remember where he hid the final egg. Then, crazy coincidences have prevented Brain from seeing a meteor shower in person.

t: Arthur: D.W., All Fired Up/I'd Rather Read It Myself
st: D.W., All Fired Up/I'd Rather Read It Myself
d: When Ms. Morgan announces they'll be having a fire drill during preschool, D.W. wants no part of it--it sounds way too scary. Then, the Tibble Twins are better than D.W. at just about everything.

t: Arthur: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Tibble/The Secret Guardians
st: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Tibble/The Secret Guardians
d: The Tibble Twins start a new business to earn enough money to buy the coveted Krummy Kreepy Kastle. When and friends stumble upon a beautiful woodland oasis right by their homes, they vow to tell no one and keep it as their secret spot.

t: Arthur: D.W., The Picky Eater/Buster And The Daredevils
st: D.W., The Picky Eater/Buster And The Daredevils
d: It's wrong to call D.W. a picky eater. The only things she won't eat are vegetables, fish, fruit, and meat. Then, Arthur and Buster meet two really cool kids and, naturally, are utterly dazzled. How far will Buster go to be cool?

t: Arthur: Francine Redecorates/Arthur The Loser
st: Francine Redecorates/Arthur The Loser
d: Francine and Catherine are very different, but it’s no fun if you're two sisters sharing the same room. Then, there's only one thing in life Arthur really wants—to win! But he just can't stop losing. Is it really so wrong to cheat a little?

t: Arthur: The Election/Francine Goes To War
st: The Election/Francine Goes To War
d: There’s a mock election in Mr. Ratburn's class, but Muffy takes it seriously. How far will she go to win? Francine can't believe it. She gets in trouble no matter what she does -- thanks to the new nosy next-door neighbor!

t: Arthur: Baby Kate and the Imaginary Mystery/Strangers on a Train
st: Baby Kate and the Imaginary Mystery/Strangers on a Train
d: Nadine, D.W.'s imaginary friend is missing. Sue Ellen can't wait to travel on an old-fashioned train, but once onboard, she discovers that the train is not as spectacular as she had hoped–until she finds a mysterious diary.

t: Arthur: The Contest/Prove It
st: The Contest/Prove It
d: What would happen if Arthur and his friends entered a contest to write stories for their favorite TV show? Then, look out world, D.W. has discovered science! But D.W.'s new-found passion proves that a little knowledge is a dangerous thing.

t: Arthur: Summer Stories
d: It’s time to celebrate summer! Join Arthur as he takes a family vacation and visits Grandpa Dave’s farm. Then, Arthur, D.W. and Buster spend a few days at the beach where they discover the simple joys of building sandcastles!

t: Arthur: Grandpa Dave's Memory Album/Buster's Carpool Catastrophe
st: Grandpa Dave's Memory Album/Buster's Carpool Catastrophe
d: Grandpa Dave is moving closer to the family, but something isn't quite right--he's forgetting all sorts of things. And Muffy, Arthur and Buster are carpooling to their cooking class. Can they stop fighting and have fun?
